Asset type: children's vocabulary learning app sprite sheet.

Scene/backdrop: completely white seamless background, subtle soft contact shadows only.
Style/medium: expressive rounded yet unmistakably recognizable forms, realistic tactile materials and fine surface detail, physically plausible soft studio lighting, polished 3D render. Match the gentle toy-like realism of a wooden bed, fabric pillow, fluffy lavender blanket, golden lamp, painted lavender wardrobe and plush bear rendered on white. Use vivid but tasteful colors. Objects have no added eyes or faces unless the subject is actually a person or body feature.

TOP RIGHT: one open book lying at a slight angle with two visible completely blank cream pages and a red cover.

BOTTOM MIDDLE: one child's school backpack, blue fabric with orange pocket, no attached toys or extra supplies.
BOTTOM RIGHT: one friendly young child standing upright, brown hair, bright yellow T-shirt and blue shorts, smiling, empty hands, shoes on.
